title: Fornax Release Trust-Boundary Delta
description: Per-candidate record of every trust boundary a release candidate's feature-delta items touch (docs/release-security-gate.md, FORNX-233). Required whenever a candidate's risk_class is TRUST_BOUNDARY or MAJOR_OR_GA (docs/release-assurance-policy.md, FORNX-229). Reviewed against, and may update, docs/security/threat-model.md.

version.description: The candidate release version this delta record is for, e.g. "v0.0.1".

threat_model_version.description: The docs/security/threat-model.md version this delta was reviewed against.

full_review.description: True when every boundary in the threat model was re-reviewed in this pass (required for a MAJOR_OR_GA candidate), not only the touched ones.

surface.description: Must be one of the trust-boundary=yes values from docs/release-candidate-evidence.md's Shared surface vocabulary. The four non-boundary surfaces (public_api_schema_migration, infra_config, cli, ui_docs) never appear here — a feature-delta item tagged only with those does not require a trust-boundary delta entry.

feature_delta_ids.description: Feature-delta item IDs (FORNX-231's FD-<version>-<seq> format) whose surfaces include this boundary.

review.description: What changed at this boundary and why it does/doesn't introduce new risk. Concrete, never a bare "looks fine."

adversarial_coverage.description: The actual falsification/negative test exercised proving the control at this boundary still rejects a bad input, named concretely (test path, or NOT_RUN plus the reason and the residual-risk implication) — never "manual review only" as a bare string.
